description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams to handle filtering parameters for employee education searches in the OrangeHRM system. It specifically manages the 'employee number' parameter and initializes the default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for filtering employee education search results, extending the generic FilterParams class with specific parameters like employee number and allowed sorting fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'e.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.
